examples.arabic: "ولكن هل هذه القرارات ستؤثر علينا كشعب؟" سأل أخي الأصغر بتوتر، وهو طالب جامعي.
examples.english: "But will these decisions affect us as a people?" my younger brother nervously asked, a university student.
examples.transliteration: "Wa-lakin hal hadhihi al-qararat sa-tu'aththir 'alayna ka-sha'b?" sa'ala akhi al-'asghar bi-tawatur, wa-huwa talib jami'i.
examples.storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

examples.arabic: سامي سأل رامي ليش هو تعبان اليوم
examples.english: Sami asked Rami why he is tired today.
examples.transliteration: sami saal rami lesh huwe taaban el yom

examples.arabic: هو سأل الخباز أبو فادي، مرحبا، كيفك، هدول بكفوا لمنقوشة زعتر؟
examples.english: He asked the baker Abu Fadi, hello, how are you, are these enough for a thyme man'oushe?
examples.transliteration: Huwwe saal el khabbaz Abu Fadi, marhaba, kifak, hadol bikaffu la manoushet zaatar?

examples.arabic: سأل أبو شادي، الخباز الختيار: "مرحبا، كيفك؟ بدي منقوشة زعتر هلق لو سمحت، بقديش؟"
examples.english: He asked Abu Shadi, the old baker: "Hello, how are you? I want a zaatar manakish now please, how much is it?"
examples.transliteration: sa'al abu shadi, el-khabbaz el-khetyar: "marhaba, kifak? biddi manqoushet zaatar hallaq law samaht, biqaddesh?"

examples.arabic: ماما شو هاد الصوت العالي وهاد الضو اللي بيطلع فجأة سأل ليث وهو بيأشر على الرعد والبرق
examples.english: "Mama what is this loud sound and this light that appears suddenly" Laith asked pointing at the thunder and lightning.
examples.transliteration: "Mama shoo had es-sowt el aali w had ed-daww illi bitla' faj'a" sa'al Laith w howe bya'asher ala er-ra'ed w el barq.

examples.arabic: سأل كريم شو عم تعملي هلأ
examples.english: Kareem asked: "What are you doing now?"
